data.long_meaning: Derived from the Persian word for 'grace' or 'beauty'. In Islamic tradition, this name embodies the virtues of grace, elegance, and beauty. The name Nen carries the meaning “Grace, beauty” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nen usually hope their child will grow to embody grace, beauty and live with faith, good character and purpose.
